title: Regular Polygon Explorer
description: An interactive MicroSim for exploring regular polygons by adjusting the number of sides, demonstrating how polygons approach circles as sides increase.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mathematics
Geometry
Polygons
learningObjectives: Identify regular polygons by their number of sides, from triangle and square through pentagon, hexagon, and beyond
Explain why every side and interior angle of a regular polygon is equal
Predict how the polygon's shape changes as the sides slider increases the vertex count
Explain how a regular polygon approaches a circle as its number of sides grows large
